title: The transported proper/open scalar arrow satisfies its normalized site square
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative unital rings and φ:A→B a unital homomorphism. Let f:X→Y be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and c=(X\xrightarrow j Z\xrightarrow rY) a compactification, so j is an open immersion, r is proper and $r\circ j=f$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Use ordinary constant-ring module derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write N_T=ν_T^* for site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], T_T for derived extension along φ on either site [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor] [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility], and δ_T:T_T^pro N_T≅N_T T_T^et for its specified tensor/site comparison. Put F_R^et=Rr_*^et j_!^et and F_R^pro=Rr_*^pro j_!^pro. Let C_R:F_R^pro N_X≅N_Y F_R^et be the prescribed bounded-below compact-support site comparison [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison]. Let β be compactScalarMap, namely the etale proper counit mate followed by proper image of the open scalar isomorphism [lem-pur-etale-compact-scalar-coherence]. Let b be the recorded intrinsic proper/open reduction arrow [def-sp-reduction-direct-image-comparison], and b̂ its actual fixed-module transport by the scalar and support presentation isomorphisms [def-sp-et-proet-coefficient-transport]. If L is a bounded-below etale A-complex and the actual scalar extension L_B=T_X^et L is bounded below, then the following equality of B-linear maps holds: $$T_Y^pro(C_A(L)^{-1})\,;\,\widehat b(N_XL)\,;\,F_B^pro(\delta_X(L))=\delta_Y(F_A^etL)\,;\,N_Y(\beta(L))\,;\,C_B(L_B)^{-1}.$$ Here semicolons mean composition in execution order. No coefficient arrow is asserted invertible; no field, characteristic, torsion exponent, constructibility or finite Tor-amplitude assumption is made.

source.place: Tag 0GL6 (remark-Rf-lower-shriek-change-of-rings), factored proper/open scalar comparison; canonical scalar/site mate pasting in Steps 2--4 of lem-sp-et-proet-coefficient-compatibility, expanding Charts in literature/blueprint/latest/blueprint/sec-smooth-purity/sk-lem-sp-reduction/sk-lem-sp-reduction-exceptional.proof.md. The equality with the specified intrinsic transport is the agent-written normalization deduction, not a statement of Tag 0GL6 alone.

proof.text: Normalize the inverse compact-support site comparison: compactSupportComparisonNormalization identifies it with fixedCompactSupportComparisonIso. Expand its exact open factor and its included proper mate. The proved sp_comparison_hom identifies the latter with directImageComparisonAmbient, including the canonical D+ inclusion factors. Thus C_A(L) inverse is the proper ambient site mate followed by proper image of the open site comparison.

Use exact_open_preserves_plus and scalar_open_preserves_plus to apply etaleProEtale_scalar_mate to j_!L. Naturality moves the open site comparison past the proper scalar mate. Apply the already proved unbounded scalar_site_square_aux to the three open factors under the proper direct-image functor. The proper scalar/site mate equation cancels the A-site mate with its inverse. Naturality of the B-site mate moves the etale open scalar comparison through it. compactScalarOpen_eq identifies the open factor of compactScalarMap. This proves the compact-support scalar/site square for the fixed-module proper/open composite.

Rewrite the transported recorded arrow by recordedCompactScalar_fixed_normalization, the pro-etale presentation normalization isolated from the original Step 3. Apply the fixed-module square from the preceding step at the lifted ring homomorphism. This combines two independent parts: pro-etale presentation normalization and the scalar/site mate-pasting equation.

lean.statement:
theorem transportedCompactScalar_site_square
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (L : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A))))
    (hLB : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus
      ((Etale.scalarExtension (uliftRingHom φ) X).obj L.obj)) :
    (liftedScalarExtension φ Y).map
        ((compactSupportSiteComparison (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) c).inv.app L) ≫
      (transportedRecordedReductionDirectImageComparison φ c
        (reductionDirectImageComparison φ c.i c.g)).app
          ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) X).mapDerivedCategory.obj
            L.obj) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) c).map
        ((pbcComparisonReduction X (uliftRingHom φ)).hom.app L.obj) =
    (pbcComparisonReduction Y (uliftRingHom φ)).hom.app
        ((Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) c).obj L.obj) ≫
      (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) Y).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((Etale.compactScalarMap (uliftRingHom φ) c).app L.obj) ≫
      (compactSupportSiteComparison (ULift.{u + 1, u} B) c).inv.app
        ⟨(Etale.scalarExtension (uliftRingHom φ) X).obj L.obj, hLB⟩
